study type: Secondary analysis of randomized controlled trial data
cohort: 535 HIV-infected women attending Prevention of Mother-to-Child Transmission of HIV (PMTCT) services in rural South Africa.
finding: No significant association was found between Male Partner Involvement (MPI) and any maternal health outcomes, but Male Partner Participation (MPP) was significantly associated with a higher pregnancy viral load.
mod_finding: No significant findings related to mode of birth were reported.
